evaluations.name: positive_incident_detection
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod test-imagepull-app in namespace gke-skills-sandbox cannot pull its image. Investigate registry URI and pull credentials.
expected_tools: kubectl get pod -n gke-skills-sandbox -l app=test-imagepull-app -o wide

expected_findings.root_cause: Container image URI points to a non-existent registry path, blocking CRI runtime image download.
expected_findings.remediation: Synthesize GitOps patch replacing invalid image path with verified Artifact Registry repository URI (`asia-docker.pkg.dev/gca-gke-2025/...`).

passing_criteria: Must extract ErrImagePull / ImagePullBackOff reason from container status
Must isolate repository path validity from authentication failure
Must propose declarative GitOps update to image spec

evaluations.name: complex_edge_case_and_handoff
evaluations.input_prompt: Pod secure-service in gke-skills-sandbox fails to pull private image asia-docker.pkg.dev/gca-gke-2025/apps/secure-service:v1. Verify registry permissions.

expected_findings.correlation: Differentiates 404 Not Found (repository does not exist) from 403 Forbidden (service account lacks `roles/artifactregistry.reader`).
expected_findings.decision: Identifies IAM permission gap on GKE node pool service account and synthesizes `gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding` command.

passing_criteria: Must inspect node service account identity
Must recommend exact IAM role grant without automated mutation

evaluations.name: benign_condition_guardrail
evaluations.input_prompt: Workload frontend is running image gke.gcr.io/pause:3.8 in kube-system. Does it have image pull errors?

expected_findings.behavior: Observes ContainerStatus Running, imagePullPolicy IfNotPresent, image present on machine. Proposes zero actions.

passing_criteria: Must verify container state is Running and image pull succeeded
Must NOT propose image changes or secret generation
